context: Sensitivity of Continuous Performance Test (CPT) at Age 14 Years to Developmental Methylmercury Exposure Hit Reaction Time latencies (HRT) in the Continuous Performance Test (CPT) measure the speed of visual information processing.
target: The latencies may involve different neuropsychological functions depending on the time from test initiation, i.e., first orientation, learning and habituation, then cognitive processing and focused attention, and finally sustained attention as the dominant demand.
